description: Free. Step 1 of having a manager created WITHOUT gas of your own on Base, Arbitrum or Unichain: Envelop's relayer sends LPManagerFactory.createManagerNondeterministic and the manager NFT goes to `owner` (explicit — never assumed to be the payer). Either `strategy` (a Think Tank id) or `product` + `pools`. Returns quoteId, the price in USDC (gas × 1.2 × fee + L1 fee, × 1.5, at least $0.10 — usually exactly $0.10), the networks to pay on (USDC on Base or Arbitrum), expiresAt (≈2 minutes), the relayer's address, balance and how many creations it has gas for on that chain, and payUrl. Refused, with nothing to pay, when the creation would revert or the relayer is out of gas. Next: create_manager(quoteId).

chainId.description: Where the manager is created: 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 130 Unichain (Ethereum mainnet: prepare_create_manager, your own gas)

name.description: Display name, up to 31 UTF-8 bytes

owner.description: Who receives the manager NFT. Explicit on purpose: a smart account on one chain may not exist on another

pools.description: Without `strategy`: the manager's pool set, 1–32, fixed forever at creation

hooks.description: Must be zero (hooked pools are not created here)

tickLower.description: Stable only: the manager's fixed range in this pool

strategy.description: A Think Tank strategy id (think-tank/<slug>) — its manager template supplies product and pools; chainId must be the strategy's chain

name: quote_create_manager
title: Quote: create a manager, gas paid by Envelop's relayer
